witnesses.separates: The one symmetric shape is symmetric about its horizontal axis and not its vertical one. The concept finds no shape the vertical mirror keeps and is undefined; $AnySym and $OddSym crop that shape.

The input holds two shapes, one symmetric about its vertical axis and one with no symmetry, so each has a symmetry set no other shape shares. $OddSym finds two odd shapes and is undefined; every other branch crops the symmetric shape.

Color 1 forms two separate pieces, one symmetric about its vertical axis and one with no symmetry. The concept takes the color's cells as one shape, which no reflection keeps, and is undefined; $Components8 crops the symmetric piece.

A cell of an asymmetric shape lies inside the bounding box of the symmetric shape. The concept draws the symmetric shape alone on the background; $GridWindow copies the box's window of the input, the intruding cell included.

A shape of color 3 covers more cells than the field of 0. The concept crops the symmetric shape of 5 on 0; the derivation takes 3 as the background and draws the same shape on 3, and $GridWindow copies the 3 cells of the shape's box. With 8-connected pieces on 3, the piece of 0 at the bottom right is kept by its diagonal mirror as well, so $AnySym and $OddSym keep two pieces and are undefined.

Three shapes are symmetric about their vertical axes only, and one has no symmetry. The concept and $AnySym keep three shapes and are undefined; $OddSym crops the asymmetric shape, whose set of symmetries no other shape has.
